work.text: There are several other surely late paintings by Shen Chou that come within the sphere of this subject matter. One is an album from the Palace collection on Formosa inscribed and dated 1494 … The album is of things taken from life. … There is an exact, brief characterization that speaks of Shen Chou’s skill

source.author: Richard Edwards

moment.text: Scholar-artists, in particular, developed a freehand-style of painting as a means to express their emotions.
In Chinese culture, different types of birds and flowers hold their own symbolic meanings; with some of them even holding auspicious meanings, scholarly and human virtues, as well as principles.

matters.text: I brushed this album for fun, painting things as they looked just to go with my leisurely and well-fed delight. But if you’re looking for me in this painting, I’m somewhere else.
